title: Patch: discovering an Anomaly is an event: the scan finds it, space tears open, your side falls into the rift and the Anomaly's own board arrives under a title card of its own
notes: boardReplaced names the Anomaly laid (R3337000); each Anomaly Found! draws its own board's picture; the probes' scan, the cast's rift set piece, a standing backdrop and a sting per Anomaly (R3337001-R3337003).

player.title: Discovering an Anomaly
changes: An Anomaly Found! in your hand now shows a picture of the board it holds: each of the ten Anomalies has its own.
When a Scanning Probe finds an Anomaly, a radar sweep crosses the board, pings, and the card flies into your hand, with a flash for a Radiant one. Your opponent sees only the sweep.
Casting an Anomaly tears a rift down your side: your cards fall in, it flares, its title card stamps across the screen and its board falls out onto your zones.
Big moments Short and Off, and Reduce Motion, play the Anomaly's moment in shorter forms.
While an Anomaly's board stands, your half of the field wears a faint backdrop of it, and each Anomaly has a sound of its own.
